name: Cali Craft Tacos
notes: 4 photos reviewed: 1 (Breakfast menu) and 2 (Bar menu) are fully legible printed menus; 3 is a single breakfast-special combo sign (not itemized, skipped); 4 is a sidewalk chalkboard storefront ad (skipped).

dishes.name: Cali Breakfast
dishes.description: A hearty California-style breakfast featuring two eggs cooked your way, served with your choice of crispy bacon, savory breakfast sausage, or sliced ham. Paired with golden hash-browns and your choice of 2 fluffy pancakes or classic French toast for a satisfying start to the day

dishes.name: Huevos Rancheros
dishes.description: Two fried eggs served over crispy corn tortillas layered with refried beans and topped with house ranchero salsa, fresh avocado, and crumbled cotija cheese

dishes.name: Chilaquiles
dishes.description: Crispy fried corn tortilla chips tossed in your choice of salsa roja or salsa verde, layered over refried beans and topped with eggs cooked to your liking, finished with avocado, crema fresca, queso fresco, and pickled onions

dishes.name: Chorizo Breakfast Plate
dishes.description: Savory pork chorizo scrambled with farm-fresh eggs, served with a side of refried beans topped with fresh pico de gallo and house-made guacamole, accompanied by two warm corn tortillas

dishes.name: Steak & Eggs
dishes.description: A hearty classic featuring a grilled Ribeye steak cooked to perfection, topped with caramelized chipotle onions, served with two eggs any style and a side of crispy hash-browns

dishes.name: Mexican Omelette
dishes.description: A hearty omelette filled with pork chorizo, melted Jack cheese, and fresh jalapenos, topped with fresh pico de gallo and guacamole, served with crispy hash-browns and a side of toast

dishes.name: Birria Quesadilla
dishes.description: Crispy corn tortillas filled with slow-braised birria beef and melted Jack cheese, grilled until golden and served with rich birria consome for dipping, pickled onions, and fresh lime

dishes.name: Street Corn Nachos
dishes.description: Crispy tortilla chips topped with grilled corn, melted Jack cheese, pico de gallo, pickled onions, crema fresca, and cotija cheese, finished with a drizzle of chipotle aioli

dishes.name: Al Pastor Street Tacos
dishes.description: Three street-style tacos filled with marinated grilled pork with pineapple chunks, fresh cilantro, chopped onions and avocado sauce, served with salsas & lime

dishes.name: Steak Street Tacos
dishes.description: Three street-style tacos filled with grilled marinated steak, topped with cilantro, chopped onions, guacamole, served with salsas and lime

dishes.name: Camaron Enchilado Tacos
dishes.description: Three tacos filled with spicy sauteed shrimp, topped with avocado, pico de gallo, shredded Jack cheese, and chipotle aioli on warm corn tortillas

dishes.name: Guacamole & Chips
dishes.description: House-made guacamole topped with pico de gallo, cotija cheese, served with fresh crispy tortilla chips

dishes.name: Cali Steak Quesadilla
dishes.description: Grilled flour tortilla stuffed with marinated steak, melted Jack cheese served with guacamole, crema fresca, pico de gallo

dishes.name: Chorizo Fundido
dishes.description: Sizzling pork chorizo with melted Jack cheese, topped with pico de gallo, served with warm corn tortillas for dipping and building tacos

dishes.name: El Jefe Burger
dishes.description: Wagyu patty, brioche bun, grilled jalapeno, chipotle mayo, avocado slices and a pickle spear

dishes.name: Cheese Burger
dishes.description: Wagyu patty, brioche bun, yellow American cheese, LTO and a pickle spear
